    Quiver data inside an algebra #

    PathData Q A records vertex idempotents e v and arrow elements α a of a ring A. Modules are left A-modules: the arrow a maps e (src a) M to e (tgt a) M. For a right module over Λ = kQ/I this is A = Λᵐᵒᵖ.

    A path is a start vertex x together with a list of arrows in traversal order; its value pval x l = α aₙ ⋯ α a₁ e x is in composition order. Lists that are not composable have value zero. The data assumes that the path values span A.
